claims.claim: Clean gamers version console loaded with ten solid games up for grabs

The 'ten solid games' claim cannot be verified without seeing the game library or a screenshot of the console's home screen.
The games mentioned are not visible in the photo. The console's home screen or game library cannot be shown to confirm the presence of these titles.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, power, cooling)
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have damaged buttons/ports
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be pirated/illegal
risks.proof: A screenshot of the PS4 home screen showing the installed games, or a video of a game being launched and played.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine PS4
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label, or a video showing the console's system information screen.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Screenshot or video of the PS4 home screen showing installed games.
Close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
